email.body1:
Tim, saw REBA acquired Markerr to add regulation-ready rent data and moved onto Microsoft Fabric, with new data flowing into Rent and Budget this quarter.

Expanding the platform that fast usually means more multifamily operators in play than the team can cover before they go quiet. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up on its own, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for REBA off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Tim, quick follow-up for REBA.

As Markerr and Fabric open new conversations, most teams do not actually know how many meetings they need to convert them, so the coverage gap shows up late and the quarter turns into a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings REBA needs to hit target, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Tim, last bit of proof for REBA.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email logged to CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how your reply rate likely compares to other proptech teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Tim, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority while you integrate Markerr, no problem at all. An acquisition integration is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a multifamily proptech motion? I will tailor it to REBA either way.
